### Naboth’s Vineyard
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/naboths-vineyard
Passage: 1 Kings 21:28-29
Points:
- Ahab and Jezebel demonstrated ruthless wickedness by murdering godly Naboth to seize his ancestral land.
- The righteous are not spared suffering on earth and may face persecution even within the visible religious community.
- Full justice is often delayed in this fallen world, but God guarantees the ultimate vindication of His people.
- God’s word of judgment is certain, shown in the promised downfall of Ahab’s royal dynasty.
- Believers must resist committing or tolerating injustice, looking forward to Christ setting all things right.
